jobs.title: Director, Revenue Operations, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.


We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice .


**Summary:**
============

We are currently seeking a **Director of Revenue Operations, Enterprise** to join our **Revenue Operations** team preferably in Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, or remotely across the U.S. or Canada (excluding Québec).  



  

**What your team does:**
------------------------

Revenue Operations has one job—to drive growth by accelerating our revenue\-generating teams. We directly support Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success by providing insights, reducing friction, and enabling teams to be innovative and self\-sufficient.  



  

**About the Role**

Clio is at an inflection point. With the strategic acquisitions of ShareDo and vLex , we are significantly expanding our enterprise footprint and investing in the dedicated operational leadership to match that ambition. The Director of Enterprise Revenue Operations will be the single operational owner responsible for scaling and maturing our Enterprise GTM motion end\-to\-end — from Sales Operations through to Customer Success operations — ensuring our Enterprise business runs with the speed, precision, and sophistication that our customers and growth targets demand.


This is a builder role. You will stand up the operational infrastructure, processes, and team that power Clio's enterprise segment. Reporting to the VP, Revenue Operations and partnering directly with the SVP of Enterprise, you will work in close collaboration with Clio's RevOps functional leaders to ensure enterprise execution is tightly integrated with the broader GTM engine.  



  

**What you'll work on:**
------------------------

**Enterprise GTM Operations**

* Build and lead the Enterprise Revenue Operations team, covering Sales, CS Operations and Analytics.
* Partner with the SVP of Enterprise to design and execute GTM strategies that enable the enterprise segment to scale
* Establish enterprise sales processes, operating cadences, and Rules of Engagement, and work with enablement to operationalize programs that equip GTM teams to execute across the full customer lifecycle
* Own enterprise post\-sales operations, ensuring onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion and professional services processes are built for enterprise complexity and scale
Ensure enterprise tooling integrates into Clio's core tech stack, partnering with the Director of GTM Applications and SMB Revenue Operations leadership team  
* 

  

**Enterprise Product and GTM Alignment**

* Partner with Product, Product Marketing and Enterprise leadership to operationalize GTM strategies across Clio’s suite including Vincent and Clio Operate
* Ensure pricing, packaging and sales motions support enterprise buyers adopting multiple products across the customer lifecycle
Develop operational frameworks that support cross\-sell and expansion within complex enterprise environments  
* 

  

**Forecasting, Planning \& Performance**

* Own pipeline and ARR forecasting across the enterprise segment, establishing the methodology and cadences that give leadership visibility into risk and upside
* Lead territory design, segmentation, quota allocation, and capacity planning, translating growth targets into actionable coverage models
* Own incentive compensation design in partnership with the Director of Compensation for the enterprise GTM organization, partnering with Finance and HR to ensure plans drive the right behaviors
Lead QBRs, MBRs and executive reporting, translating performance data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leadership  
* 

  

**GTM Data \& Insights**

* Define how GTM metrics are measured, distributed, and actioned across the enterprise segment; covering pipeline health, conversion, retention, expansion, and efficiency
* Partner with Data \& Finance to maintain clean, consistent GTM data infrastructure and support board\-level reporting
Own analytics and build the analytics muscle for Enterprise  
* 

  

**What you bring:**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree; MBA preferred
* 7\+ years as a Senior Manager of RevOps or 3\+ years as a Director of RevOps in a B2B SaaS environment
* Experience building or scaling Enterprise GTM operations, ideally in a company moving upmarket
* Management experience required — 3\+ direct reports
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations for senior leadership
* Comfortable in a matrix environment — influencing without direct authority across multiple functional teams
* Roll\-up\-your\-sleeves mentality — this is a builder role, not a manager\-only role
* Proficiency with core GTM tools including Salesforce, SalesLoft, Gong, CPQ platforms, and familiarity with Professional Services Automation (PSA) and Customer Success platforms
* Ability to travel to or within Canada one week per quarter

  

This role is a backfill for an existing position.
**What you will find here:**

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high\-performing culture.  

  



**Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:**

* Competitive, equitable salary with top\-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
* Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
* Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
* $2000 annual counseling benefit
* RRSP matching and RESP contribution
* Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

jobs.title: Head of Platform (Infrastructure & DevOps)
jobs.description:
**What we are building**
------------------------


Mimica is an AI\-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.


Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data\-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.


We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start\-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.  

  

**Our team**


Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote\-first and globally distributed across 16\+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast\-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom\-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

**Your mission**
----------------


Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale.


The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10\+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows.


This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi\-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure.


We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background.


What matters more than your origin story is your hands\-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you.

=============================

* Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards.
* Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub\-team split (Cloud \& Developer Platform, Reliability \& SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows.
* Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access.
* Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture \- improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise.
* Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship.
* Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on\-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning.
* Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki).
* Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap.
* Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high\-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest.
* Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering\-wide standards for reliability, on\-call, CI/CD and craft.
* Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence.

**Requirements**
================

* **Proven experience leading engineers**, ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub\-team design.
* Solid hands\-on experience with **Kubernetes**, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions.
* Proven experience with infrastructure\-as\-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool.
* A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on\-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery.

Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Content Delivery, the **Director, Digital Storefront Performance \& Insights** will lead the measurement, performance intelligence, reporting and insights function for Manulife's Global Digital Storefront.

  



This role is accountable for Digital Storefront's end\-to\-end performance intelligence, from establishing measurement before launch and driving daily oversight through hypercare, to enabling continuous optimization and demonstrating enterprise\-wide performance and value realization.

  



This strategic leader will define how Digital Storefront measures success, lead and orchestrate cross\-functional teams responsible for delivering integrated performance intelligence and own the development and continuous evolution of a centralized Power BI dashboard that enables self\-service reporting across Global and Segment teams.

A critical aspect of this role is demonstrating the ongoing value created through Digital Storefront, including its contribution to lead generation and conversion across the broader customer journey, as well as AI\-enabled transformation. * Leverage AI and automation to enhance monitoring, detect anomalies, accelerate insight generation and improve reporting efficiency

jobs.title: Director, Sponsor Analytics
jobs.description:
The Director, Sponsor Analytics will lead the Sponsor Analytics function within Group Benefits, with primary accountability for delivering meaningful, actionable insights and reporting to plan sponsors, Distribution partners and internal business leaders.

  

  

The Director will shape the strategy and evolution of sponsor reporting and analytics, ensuring sponsors have access to trusted, relevant and increasingly sophisticated insights to better understand their benefits programs, member populations and key areas of opportunity. Through improved use of data and insights, the role will support informed decisions that contribute to healthier outcomes and the health and well\-being of Canadians.

  

  

The Director will also lead and contribute to broader analytics initiatives across Group Benefits where the team’s capabilities, data and expertise can create value, including strategic business priorities, portfolio analytics, operational insights, customer and member analytics, and emerging analytical needs.


Working closely with Plan Sponsor Services, Distribution, Product, Operations, Data and Technology partners, the Director will lead the development and evolution of standardized and customized reporting, self\-service analytics, data products and insights. The role will balance evolving sponsor and business needs with scalable solutions, strong data governance, appropriate data protection and a focus on business value and customer outcomes.

  

  

The Director will lead and develop a high\-performing analytics team, establishing clear priorities, strengthening analytical capabilities and fostering a culture focused on meaningful outcomes for sponsors and the broader Group Benefits business.

  



**Position Responsibilities:**

  

  

* **Lead the Sponsor Analytics function and team.** Establish priorities and a roadmap aligned with the Group Benefits sponsor reporting and analytics strategy, while coaching and developing a collaborative, accountable and high\-performing team.
* **Partner with plan sponsors, Distribution and business leaders.** Translate sponsor and business needs into meaningful reporting, analytics and insights, balancing individual requests with strategic priorities and scalable solutions.
* **Advance the sponsor reporting strategy.** Evolve traditional reporting toward proactive, insight\-driven analytics that help sponsors understand their benefits programs, emerging trends and opportunities for action.
* **Lead sponsor\-facing analytics products and reporting.** Oversee standardized and customized reporting, dashboards and self\-service capabilities, ensuring a consistent and effective sponsor experience.
* **Use analytics to improve outcomes for sponsors and members.** Identify trends, opportunities and insights that support informed benefits decisions and contribute to improving the health and well\-being of Canadians.
* **Support broader Group Benefits analytics priorities.** Apply the team’s capabilities and expertise to strategic business questions across product, customer, member, portfolio and operational analytics.
* **Identify emerging analytical opportunities.** Partner with business leaders to frame questions, assess available data, develop analytical approaches and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* **Strengthen data storytelling.** Translate complex information into clear, relevant and actionable insights for sponsors, Distribution partners and senior business leaders.
* **Drive consistency, efficiency and automation.** Simplify reporting and analytical processes, reduce manual effort and create reusable capabilities that scale across Group Benefits.
* **Advance the analytics data ecosystem.** Partner with Data and Technology teams to establish the data, platforms and capabilities required for reliable, timely and increasingly sophisticated analytics.
* **Champion data quality, governance and protection.** Ensure reporting and analytical products use trusted data and adhere to enterprise governance, privacy and data protection standards.
* **Establish measures of success.** Define and monitor adoption, stakeholder value, reporting effectiveness, operational efficiency and advancement of analytical capabilities.
* **Drive innovation and continuous improvement.** Assess emerging technologies, analytical techniques and business opportunities that can improve sponsor insights and create value across Group Benefits.
* **Represent Sponsor Analytics in cross\-functional forums.** Ensure sponsor reporting and broader analytics requirements are considered in Group Benefits data, product and technology decisions.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

  

* University degree in business, finance, analytics, technology, mathematics, engineering or another quantitative field. An advanced degree is considered an asset.
* Significant leadership experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting or a related data function, including leading teams through change and transformation.
* Strong experience developing client\-, sponsor\- or externally facing analytics and reporting solutions and translating complex data into meaningful business insights.
* Demonstrated ability to apply analytics across business problems, including recurring reporting, exploratory analysis, strategic insights and scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of the Group Benefits business and the needs of plan sponsors, Distribution partners and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing analytics and reporting strategies that balance immediate stakeholder needs with longer\-term scalable capabilities.
* Experience partnering with Distribution and client\-facing teams and using data visualization and storytelling to communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with modern analytics, business intelligence and data technologies, including dashboards, automated reporting and self\-service analy

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance and Operations
jobs.description:
**Make a difference in brain research and innovation in Ontario**

  



Ontario Brain Institute (OBI) is a provincially funded, not\-for\-profit research organization driving discovery and innovation to improve brain health. Through collaborative research, data sharing, commercialization, and community engagement, OBI accelerates the translation of knowledge into real\-world impact.

  



OBI is passionate about the outcomes of its work, the people and organizations with whom it partners, and the opportunity to play a role in shaping the future. Its members are united in the common goal to improve brain health.

  



To learn more about our organization and achievements to date visit our website.

 **Vice President, Finance \& Operations**



OBI is seeking a Vice President, Finance \& Operations to provide strategic leadership for the organization's financial sustainability, corporate operations, governance, and enterprise risk.

  

As a member of OBI's Executive Team, the Vice President, Finance \& Operations works across OBI's related entities, serving as a strategic partner to the CEO \& Scientific Director, President \& COO, and the broader Executive Team, helping shape priorities, evaluate opportunities, develop sustainable financial and business models, and translate strategy into executable financial plans.

  

The role safeguards organizational assets, strengthens financial decision\-making, and ensures that corporate systems and resources effectively support OBI's mission and long\-term priorities, while fostering accountability and responsible stewardship.

  


**Role and Responsibilities**

  

***Financial Strategy \& Sustainability***


* Lead long\-term financial planning, annual budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling, and strategic resource allocation.
* Advise the CEO \& Scientific Director, President \& COO, Executive Team, and Board on financial performance, sustainability, emerging risks, and opportunities.
* Lead the development and evaluation of sustainable financial and business models that support OBI’s evolving mandate, including new revenue opportunities, partnerships, funding arrangements and organizational structures.
* Establish meaningful financial measures and reporting that support timely, evidence\-based decisions.

  


***Multi\-Entity Financial Leadership***


* Provide coordinated financial leadership across the Institute, Foundation, and any future related entities, while respecting each entity’s governance, mandate, and independence.
* Oversee consolidated and entity\-level budgeting, reporting, cash\-flow management, and financial planning.
* Assess resource needs, shared\-service opportunities, and financial interdependencies across entities, while maintaining appropriate governance, cost allocation, and accountability.
* Support effective relationships among management, Boards, committees, funders, auditors, financial institutions, and external advisors.

  


***Strategic Investment \& Capital Management***


* Lead the financial evaluation of new initiatives, partnerships, investment opportunities, and revenue\-generating activities.
* Provide financial leadership on strategic growth initiatives, including resource planning and operating structures.
* Oversee financial planning in accordance with approved policies and risk tolerances.

  


***Financial Governance \& Enterprise Risk***


* Maintain a strong framework of financial policies, procedures, delegated authorities, internal controls, and accountability.
* Oversee financial reporting, audit, tax, statutory filings, regulatory requirements, and funder compliance.
* Lead enterprise risk management and ensure material financial and operational risks are identified, assessed, monitored, and addressed.
* Prepare clear, accurate, and timely reports and recommendations for the Executive Team, Board, and relevant committees.
  


***Corporate Operations \& Shared Services***


* Provide executive oversight of finance, procurement, contracting, insurance, facilities, IT, and administrative systems.
* Improve processes, systems, and service standards to deliver efficient, responsive, and scalable organizational support.
* Ensure procurement and contracting practices demonstrate value, fairness, transparency, appropriate due diligence, and sound risk management.
* Lead the selection, implementation, and effective use of financial and operational technology.

  


***People \& Organizational Leadership***


* Build, coach, and lead a high\-performing Finance \& Operations team with clear priorities, accountabilities, and development plans.
* Partner with leaders across OBI to strengthen financial literacy, planning discipline, and shared stewardship of resources.

jobs.title: Director of AI Applications Development
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

As part of CIBC’s technology team, you’ll lead our AI Applications Development function and guide a high\-performing team of AI engineers, developers, and quality assurance specialists who build and support enterprise\-grade AI solutions. As Director, you’ll provide technical and people leadership to drive the design, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of advanced AI applications across the bank. You’ll work closely with technology and business partners to shape solution architecture, define integration requirements, and deliver solutions that align to strategic priorities and enterprise standards. You’ll help ensure our AI\-driven applications are secure, scalable, reliable, and well monitored, with a strong focus on cloud\-native delivery, observability, and compliance. You’ll also foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and strong documentation practices while supporting your leaders and teams in delivering high\-quality solutions that enhance the client experience.

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

* **Strategic partnership \-** Build trusted relationships with technology and business partners, vendors, and senior stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into practical AI solutions, and influence decisions through clear, business\-focused communication.

* **Quality and platform excellence \-** Champion strong engineering practices across cloud infrastructure, continuous integration and continuous delivery, observability, documentation, and test automation to help ensure solutions are resilient, maintainable, and ready for enterprise scale.
* **Delivery leadership \-** Work with internal partners to prioritize, plan, and deliver initiatives on agreed timelines and budgets. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, encourage reuse across teams, and help shape a shared AI strategy that scales across the enterprise.
  

**Who you are**


* **You are a hands\-on builder first.** You have recently designed, built, and shipped production AI applications yourself, and you still enjoy writing code, reviewing pull requests, and solving production issues alongside the team.
* **You bring strong technical depth.** You have hands\-on experience with Python, FastAPI, JavaScript (Vue.js or React.js), SQL, Redis, and Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry and API Management. You are comfortable with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions and QA automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

* **You're digitally savvy.** You are curious, adapt quickly to new tools and trends, and take ownership of outcomes in a fast\-moving space.

The Director, Sponsor Analytics will lead the Sponsor Analytics function within Group Benefits, with primary accountability for delivering meaningful, actionable insights and reporting to plan sponsors, Distribution partners and internal business leaders.

The Director AI Business Solutions will be responsible for guiding and implementing the AI strategy across the Canadian Wealth Management (CWM) businesses, ensuring business strategies, plans and initiatives are executed / delivered in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures.

* Strong business judgment and ability to translate technical concepts into actionable business strategies
* Excellent technical project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Strong leadership skills to develop and manage a team focused on driving AI initiatives
* Ability to use an agile approach to develop key talent, capabilities and assets with a rapid prototyping mindset
* Ability to identify opportunities, manage demand, and support the development of AI use cases
* MBA, CFA and/or experience in consulting is an asset.

  

**What's in it for you?**

An inclusive working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success! jobs.title: Director, Financial Reporting and Analysis , Global FP&A
jobs.description:
Overview:

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.  

The Global Reporting and Analysis team is accountable for collecting and analysing KPMG’s key data and metrics across the network of member firms. The team is fully dedicated to providing value added management information and insight to help global leadership progress KPMG’s strategic plans and priorities. Revenue reporting (by function, region, sector and client) is a particular focus, but the data collected and analysed covers a wider range of profitability and people metrics. The function also generates KPMG's external reporting of financial data, including press statements and ESG reporting.
What you will do:
* Internal financial Reporting \- Delivery of the aggregated financial results of the KPMG network, including the reporting of revenues, headcount and profitability metrics
* External financial reporting on KPMG’s global results to the market and the Professional Indemnity Insurance (PII) reinsurers.
* Business planning and strategic analysis in support of KPMG’s Collective Strategy, providing Board\-level insight and including competitor analysis.
* Continuous improvement and change management, driving evolution of reporting to meet the business’ information requirements.
* Process and team management lead, coach and develop four direct reports and coordinate the work of the offshore team members.
* Management of the annual process that reviews the Global Taxonomy of Services, which defines the reporting and supports risk management.

  


What you bring to this role:
* Minimum 10 years of relevant financial reporting and analysis experience, with an accounting qualification
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
* Extensive reporting systems experience, with SAP or similar and interest in applying automation and AI
* Advanced capability in data manipulation \& modelling with a creative approach to presenting information to stakeholders
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed environment, across different cultures, ideally with experience of directing offshore teams and expert knowledge of a professional services firm
* A collaborative approach to building relationships with stakeholder

  

The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $175,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills \& competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program. **Providing you with the support you need to be at your best**  


Our Values, The KPMG Way:
**Integrity**, we do what is right \| **Excellence**, we never stop learning and improving \| **Courage**, we think and act boldly \| **Together**, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences \| **For Better**, we do what matters  

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier\-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice. **Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process**  

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1\-888\-466\-4778\. **AI Usage**  

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.  

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology\-first, people\-driven firm.

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.  

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology\-first, people\-driven firm.
